partial_match_policy: weaker attributes separate; they do not count as exact full-reference recovery
missing_policy: Invalid generations stay missing; main coverage denominators use the same valid full-dialogue cohort
limitations: AI provisional reference and same-assistant adjudication
unequal model inputs; NOT a pure capability gap
reference A support is provisional and incomplete, not a proven information ceiling
confidence is self-reported; agreement F1 is not factual accuracy
coarse and specific assertions can be statistically dependent
new reference frozen before viewing new Qwen outputs; old reference timing unchanged
new 80 random unobserved test dialogues; old 32 mixed random/enriched development dialogues
new and old API runs on different dates; same requested model and settings, backend version not guaranteed
